answer: Mandatory fraud insurance priced per identity turns every fake into a separate bet against underwriters. Each seat needs a policy from staked underwriters who pay a 500 POA claim from their own vault if that seat is later proven a clone. Premiums scale with similarity to seats already insured: a newcomer whose behaviour kernel (timing, phrasing, funding lineage) matches 10 others pays about 11 times the base rate. A falcon-eyed underwriter profits by repricing clusters, so the 50th lookalike costs far more than the first, and one policy never covers two seats.
